title: Testing subscriptions with Stripe Test Clocks and Workbench
summary: Validating payment logic that gets triggered over a period of time is challenging and sometimes results in inelegant solutions.The combination of test clocks and workbench will improve the ability for developers to build and debug recurring payments.
